description: This Java class 'WorkingDaysReadPlatformServiceImpl' implements the 'WorkingDaysReadPlatformService' interface. It provides functionality to retrieve working days data and repayment reschedule options from a database, using JDBC template and mapping SQL result sets to domain data objects. It handles fetching specific working days configurations and enumerations related to repayment rescheduling.

classes.name: WorkingDaysMapper
classes.description: A private inner class that implements RowMapper to convert SQL result set rows into WorkingDaysData objects.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a row from ResultSet to a WorkingDaysData object.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Fetches working days data from the database or throws exception if not found.

methods.name: repaymentRescheduleType
methods.description: Returns a WorkingDaysData object containing repayment reschedule options.

methods.name: repaymentRescheduleTypeOptions
methods.description: Generates a collection of EnumOptionData for different repayment rescheduling options.
